subject.title: fix(firecrawl,brave,web-search,web-fetch,models-config): use own-property checks for config field lookups

question: After fixing the Brave nullish fallback regression, should supported in-memory OpenClawConfig and provider model objects uniformly reject inherited fields as configured values?
rationale: Persisted JSON/JSON5 config does not establish the claimed prototype path, but several affected helpers accept direct programmatic objects, so the remaining broad semantics change requires maintainer intent about compatibility.

options.title: Own properties only
options.body: Define supported config and model inputs as own-property records, retain justified checks, and add exact-head contract proof.

options.title: Narrow to proven boundaries
options.body: Preserve inherited-field behavior on direct-call APIs and harden only demonstrated hostile ingestion boundaries.

recommendation.title: Own properties only
recommendation.body: Define supported config and model inputs as own-property records, retain justified checks, and add exact-head contract proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced the current consolidated implementations across most affected surfaces and is the strongest available owner for the cross-cutting configuration contract.
